'''Jesús Julián Lucendo''' (born 19 April 1970) is a former [[Andorra]]n [[Andorra national football team|national footballer]] of Spanish origin.  He made 27 appearances internationally for Andorra.<ref>Duret, Sésbastien. "Andorra – Record International Players." 3 January 2008. http://www.rsssf.com/miscellaneous/ando-recintlp.html</ref> He had an extensive club career as well, including one season with [[FC Barcelona]]. He retired in November 2003 due to a knee injury.<ref>"Player retirements (2003/2004)." http://www.globalsoccertransfers.com/player/retired.html</ref><ref>Bright, Richard. "Inzaghi is hopeful for Ajax match." 18 November 2003. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/main.jhtml?xml=/sport/2003/11/19/sfninz19.xml]{{dead link|date=July 2021|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}}</ref>
